description.en: Exact Char catalog spelling, alternate source behavior, error-carrier differences and absent-provider audit at one compiler snapshot. This is not a full CPU implementation claim.
description.ko: 한 컴파일러 스냅샷에서 Char 카탈로그 표기·대체 소스 동작·오류 전달 타입 차이·제공자 부재를 구분한다. CPU 전체 구현의 완성을 뜻하지 않는다.

direct_namespace.validation: All107 catalog calls were compile-checked with basic valid argument types; none was executed. Each failed because the Char namespace has no concrete callable binding in the audited compiler.
direct_namespace.boundary: A prelude namespace symbol is not a public operation implementation; later Char compiler changes require a new audit.

sources.role: Prelude Char namespace registration; no operation implementation implied
Type-directed char.parse dispatch; no Char numeric scalar conversion dispatch
Actual scalar, numeric and text operation contracts
Strict exact-one scalar parse, shortest UTF8 and scalar-domain checks
Explicit ASCII char/byte/text overloads; not Unicode property operations
Strict UTF scalar/code-unit foundation with u32 Decoded.scalar and EncodingError

compiler_prerequisites: Exact nonfallible Char.to_u32(char)->u32 and checked Char.from_u32(u32)->Result<char, explicit error> without numeric reinterpretation or allocation.
Keep Unicode scalar invariants: reject surrogates/>0x10ffff; preserve U+0000/noncharacters/unassigned scalars.
Retain canonical builtin identity and strict result shapes through lowering/AIR/JIT.
source_surface: ASCII blank/sign/compare and checked ASCII encode/decode
Exact-one UTF8/UTF16 decode, prefix decode, bounded encode and fixed zero-padded output
Escape/U+ parsing and owned scalar-to-string with explicit allocation errors
testing: Every Unicode scalar plus surrogate/out-of-range errors
Every ASCII input and byte boundary, binary UTF malformed boundaries, output preserved on short capacity
Exact payloads, allocation failure and same-name namespace regressions
later_ucd: Pin a chosen released Unicode dataset version, its hashes and license before property/classification/name/case/segmentation tables.
Do not replace Unicode operations with ASCII or locale-dependent host libc.
Define scalar-only full-case behavior separately from string-context/locale-sensitive casing.
